execute_sql.rationale: `Execute SQL queries on the sqlite database` with `SQL to execute` can run SELECT-style queries against a database and return database contents, so it can expose non-public database data. The description does not say who can write the database contents; conservatively, returned rows may include attacker-authored data, so UNTRUSTED is kept and this is marked undetermined. It is not labeled SINK because writing to a sqlite database is not advertised as sending data to an attacker-readable destination, and it is not labeled HOSTEXEC because only SQL execution, not arbitrary host code execution, is advertised.

search_objects.rationale: `Search and list database objects on the sqlite database` can return database schema/object information, which may be non-public database metadata, so SECRET applies. The description includes `Detail: names (minimal), summary (metadata), full (all)` and does not say whether object names or metadata can be authored by outside parties; conservatively, returned names/metadata may be attacker-authored, so UNTRUSTED is kept and this is marked undetermined. It is a read-only listing/search tool and is not advertised as sending data to an attacker-readable destination or executing host code.

notes: No source code was provided; judgments are based only on the advertised tool descriptions, schemas, and annotations.
